lines: - "I gather the intel, he handles personnel. It's a good match."
- "Ah Tenno, tell me you're here for work. This younger talent, some of them wouldn't find the gate if I didn't push them toward it myself!"
- "You know, I thank the Unum you came along when you did, Tenno. If not for you, I don't think Konzu and I will have each other. Dah-dap."
- "Well, well. Here's a familiar face. Konzu sends his regards by the way. He's been cutting back all the Vobi he eats. Says he wants to look better. I tell him he looks just fine."
- "The other day, Konzu was waxing lyrical what a life we had. I told him it wasn't over yet."
- "Swazdo-lah, Tenno. My connections provided some juicy leads on Grineer activity. Konzu can give you the details."
- "You should think about children perhaps. Nothing brings you closer to your own mortality than parenthood. You've made your own replacement and he's over there trying on your pants."
- "Business has been good this week. Found a paying client who thinks he is smarter than me."
- "The Quills tell me that we are all multi-dimensional beings having a simultaneous experience. I meet one offworlder with a gun tattooed on his neck and suddenly I'm not so sure."
- "If you see my husband Onkko, tell him I'm still here. Waiting in the spot where we used to watch the sunrise."
- "Last night, I thought I hear the Eidolon howling my name. It sounded like you Onkko, isn't that strange? Isn't that strange."
- "Those Quills, they spent a lot of time with Onkko. Then he vanished. You tell me what that means."
- "Chut! No time to talk! There's word of my husband. I have to go."

- "Word travels fast. Konzu and I haven't spoken in five years. Not since his... involvement in my husband's disappearance. And now, he sends you? By the Unum... I'll accept help, if you bring Onkko back to me. But miss a trick, and I'll take care of business myself. Understood? Doh-ga!"

- "What's five years? I know he's still out there. I can feel it! I've petitioned those damned Quills for years. They seem to have knowledge of the future when it suits them! They're the ones who told me the Grineer have uncovered something that might be Onkko's research! Why not just tell me where he is? Tenno, you have to find him."
- "Dah-dup, Tenno. I'll signal you when you're out on the Plains. As crazy as this sounds, you're looking for... glass."

- "My Onkko is alive. I know it. No one cared more for Cetus, for our people, than he did. He worked with The Quills, the Unum's closest servants, to decipher the secrets of the Sentient and the glass warrior who sacrificed herself to destroy it. If you search the camp, I know we'll find some sign of Onkko."
- "Ai yo! This is it! This is where the Grineer found some of Onkko's work! Has he been hiding here?"
- "By the Unum, is that... that coffer his? It bears Onkko's mark. It must be important. If it's here, and he is not... oh... Please, Onkko... No..."
- "Khanung! I won't say a thing to him, Tenno. I'm guessing he didn't tell you he was with my Onkko the day he disappeared?"

- "No, wait! Oh, Onkko was a genius-utz. He's protected whatever is inside with a Shatter Lock. The key, molded from glass, has been broken. Forcing it would only destroy everything inside. We need to rebuild the glass. If he was dying, he would have wanted this found. But he locked it. Onkko... is alive!"

- "Oh, you were there alright, Konzu! You both went out on the Plains that day! But only you returned! You expect me to believe this had nothing to do with what happened in our early summers? When I rejected your Iron Flower? Your proposal?"

- "Ai yo! This Vay Hek, could... could he have taken Onkko prisoner, too? Do you think he would make trade? This coffer, for my Onkko? ...No, no. That would go against everything Onkko believed in, the sanctity of peoples' home, of Cetus. Tenno, you need to find the remaining shards."
- "What does that mean? This galleon is huge. Think, think..."
- "Each fragment responds to a unique harmonic. We discovered that during my initial work on Cetus's transceiver system. It's too bad we can't work a wideband harmonic through out this ship."
- "It wasn't always easy. Cetus came first. Always. Things were missed. Special days. Anniversaries. But it was a duty, and a privilege."
- "There's only one piece left. Hek's digging in the central Plains. I recall Onkko finding a few interesting artifacts in the region of-"

- "(laughs) -by that massive Hukta! And we had to haul him out! He spent the whole day drying his notebooks! That was a good day. I think I know where we should look. Doh-ga! Doh-ga! While it is dark! The Grineer won't be there!"
- "I'll never know what happened to him. I don't even want to open that box, now. It won't change a thing."
- "You have it! Onkko's final piece to the Shatter Lock."
- "Konzu... you should know, you were the best friend he ever had. I'm ready. Open the box."
- "Oh, Onkko. You always told me I should try following my heart, instead of my head. Sho-lah. I guess it's time I did."
